survivors_flagged.one_line: 180-day IPO lockup on ~97% of Class A shares (May-13 IPO at $27) expires around Nov 9, the same day as Q3 results. The stock already trades ~46% below the IPO price after a short report and law-firm notices. The lockup date is my estimate; the 424B4 prospectus will confirm it. This is an early-arc overhang-clearing setup: watch whether supply clears once the lockup ends.

verified.instrument: FRVO common (NASDAQ). No position is warranted before lockup supply hits and Q3 results answer the short report.
verified.bloom_gates: None passed. G1: no named counterparty (the lockup release is a supply event, not a buyer). G2: no concrete commitment such as a buyback, take-out or financing backstop. G3: no specific unpriced figure, since the lockup is a public, widely known date and the Q3 numbers are unknown. Dated: yes (results confirmed, lockup estimated). Forward: yes. Not a macro bet: yes.
verified.edge: L. A lockup expiry is a known, scheduled event, and the supply is usually priced in or hits on the day. 'Overhang clearing' is a hoped-for price pattern after the event, not a value-unlocking event. (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: NEGATIVE, about -43%. The stock was $14.33 at the Oct-6 Morpheus short-report close and is $8.16 now (FMP quote 2026-11-02), about 70% below the $27 IPO price, not the 46% stated in the triage. So nothing is harvested, but a falling knife is not residual capture. (b) Remaining % to a favorable-resolution value: not derivable. There is no contractual or SoP numerator, and the company is pre-revenue (Q2 revenue $113k vs $241k estimated; EPS -0.38). Any upside figure would be a guess about sentiment, not a re-derived value.

verified.analysis: Confirmed: Q3 results on 2026-11-09 (GlobeNewswire release 2026-10-30, FMP earnings calendar), the Morpheus short report of 2026-10-06 (thermal decline, water loss, seismicity damage) and repeated law-firm investigation notices. The stock has kept falling, to $8.16 versus $14.33 on Oct 6, so the triage figure of '46% below the IPO price' is stale. Gap: the lockup date and its ~97% coverage were not checked against the 424B4 (the web-search budget for this turn was used up), and no 10-Q capital-structure lookup was done. That lookup matters less here because the thesis has no derived upside numerator. The setup does not pass any Bloom gate: it is lockup supply landing on a binary results/short-report rebuttal day for a pre-revenue name under litigation, so it is a sentiment trade, not a catalyst. Re-look only if, after Nov 9, there is visible insider or sponsor non-selling, a named strategic investor, or Q3 data that specifically refutes the short report's operating claims.

verified.edge: M. (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: about +6% (2026-07-01 close $117.40, the day before the +13% gap to $132.57 on 07-02, to $124.2 today). Measured from the June lows around $98 it is about +27%. After the Q3 miss the stock gave back the whole post-announcement premium. (b) Remaining to the provenance-checked SoP: about +15-20%, to roughly $140-150. Motion at about 14x EBITDA on ~$1.2B, Automotive at about 9x on ~$1.45B, less about $3B capitalized corporate cost, less $6.06B net debt incl leases, over 137.9M shares. Edge is moderate: mostly unharvested, but the gap depends on the multiples assumed, and dis-synergies plus separation costs eat into it.

verified.analysis: The separation is real, dated and committed: Q1-2027 completion was reaffirmed on 2026-09-09 with leadership named, and the Q3 release (2026-10-20) narrowed adj EPS guidance to $7.50-7.75 from $7.50-8.00, citing separation costs. The capital structure is clean: 10-Q 2026-09-30 shows $5.11B debt + $1.71B leases, $0.76B cash, no preferred, 137.9M shares. So the SoP numerator holds for the equity, but the upside is a multiple-arbitrage on Motion that the market already knows about, not a hidden figure. The 2026-07-02 announcement premium is fully round-tripped. That keeps roughly 15-20% on the table into the December investor days, so this rates WATCH, not ACTIVE. Gap: web search budget was exhausted, so segment EBITDA and peer multiples are estimates, not taken from the filing segment note.
